newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka stocks seen poised up on wide interest.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka stocks seen poised up on wide interest.

text.p: Sri Lankan stocks, which gained over 70 points in the last two weeks, were seen poised upward on Monday on the back of good investor sentiment and buying interest, brokers said.
"We're expecting another good day. There is foreign interest, focused mainly on blue chips," said Rajiv Casiechitty of CT Smith Stock Brokers.
"If sufficient quantitites are available, they will go through easily, boosting turnover," he said.
On Friday, the all share closed 14.4 points up at 721.2 on a high turnover of 165.6 million rupees.

Investor sentiment has been buyoed by a cut in reserve ratios, easing interest rates, a sweeping local election win by the government and its agreement with the opposition to work together to end the ethnic crisis, brokers say.
Other brokers said a lack of sellers may hold the market down at least momentarily.

"There are a lot of purchase orders at high margins, but we can't source quantity," said a trader at brokerage Bartleet Mallory. "Some sellers are holding on, hoping to sell at higher prices down the line. They know the market is going up."
